name: llama.cpp
description: Installs llama.cpp prebuilt binaries, including llama-server, for local LLM serving.

version.description: llama.cpp GitHub release tag to install. Use 'latest' for the current release, or a tag such as 'b9360'.

backend.description: Upstream prebuilt backend to install. GPU backends require matching runtime libraries and drivers from the base image or host.
